propositions: Close-reason and force logic is duplicated across three surfaces (CLI transition.py:584, library _lib_writes.py:318, MCP _mcp_writes.py:224-232) with inconsistent behaviour: CLI refuses inadmissible reasons while library silently discards them.
The '(no reason given)' placeholder string is produced at five code sites across three files (_lib_writes.py:247,412; transition.py:396; claim.py:43,46) with no single canonical source.
MCP transition_ticket does not expose reason parameter, causing write-parity contract xfail (scratchy-leprous-galago); reason accepted upstream is never read (defiant-orthoclase-buck pattern).

Bare --force with empty force_reason works only because _force_note normalizes '' to placeholder before close_ticket; any signature change or normalization reordering relative to refusal check at txn.py:232 flips acceptance to refusal.
Placeholder normalizing to close_disposition.verdict converts UNJUSTIFIED disposition to SIGNED, violating the guard that empty reason must fail closed (close_disposition.py:200-201).
